description: Figure 8 illustrates relative performance change (in percent) across different layer ranges for layer-wise quantized pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct using SnapKV at a KV cache budget of 1/64, with multiple methods/bit-width settings plotted against a dashed baseline. The x-axis is categorical and labeled by layer groups: “Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32,” spaced evenly from left to right. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and uses a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 5% intervals, spanning from about −25% at the bottom to about +5% at the top, and a horizontal dashed line marks the 0% baseline. Five lines are shown: an orange solid line with circular markers (LB-Avg of 2+tokens, 8-bit) stays close to 0%, starting near 0% at Layer1-4, dipping slightly below 0% around Layer5-12, and returning to around 0% by Layer29-32; a red solid line with circular markers (LB-Avg of 1+tokens, 16-bit) remains slightly above 0% throughout, around ~2% at Layer1-4, dipping toward ~1% near Layer13-20, and ending near ~2% at Layer29-32; a light-blue solid line with circular markers (RULER4k of 2+tokens, 8-bit) begins slightly below 0% (around −2% at Layer1-4), drops further to roughly −10% at Layer13-20, then rises back to around −2% by Layer29-32; a dark-blue solid line with circular markers (RULER4k of 1+tokens, 16-bit) starts near −2% at Layer1-4, declines to about −25% at Layer13-20, and then increases to roughly −3% by Layer29-32; and a gray dashed horizontal line (Baseline of 4+tokens, 4-bit) stays at 0% across all layer groups.
